issues.description: The UML in the problem statement declares Stock.add(String) as returning void, but both the template and solution implementations define Stock.add(String) to return an int (the new quantity) which is used by other logic. This discrepancy between the UML/spec and the provided code can confuse students about the correct method signature and return value to implement or rely on.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the specification/UML consistent with the code: update the UML and problem statement to declare Stock.add(String): int (returning the updated quantity), or alternatively change the template/solution to have add return void and adjust usages. Prefer updating the UML/spec to int to match the implemented behavior.
